Class Item

java.lang.Object
Item
public class Item extends Object
Represents Items that the Player can have.

Tracks the availability and price of the item, and tracks how many copies of itself the Player has.

    • itemCode

      private int itemCode
      A code representing which item this is. The following item codes represent:
      • 1 - Mikan Mochi
      • 2 - Air Shoes
      • 3 - Bat Tamer
      • 5 - Choco-Mint Ice Cream
      • 6 - Kurosawa Macha
      • 7 - Shovel Upgrade
      • 8 - Stewshine
      • 10 - Tears of a Fallen Angel
      • 11 - Noppo Bread
